task_title: Find the token-accounting bug in the scorecard SQL
output:
(1) Bug: avg_tokens only sums `inputTokens` + `outputTokens` and drops `cacheReadInputTokens` / `cacheCreationInputTokens` from `usage_json`.  
(2) Why it matters: with subscription billing `cost_cents` is always 0, so tokens are the only cost signal; omitting cache tokens undercounts real usage and skews cost and quality-per-token rankings (cache-heavy agents look cheaper/more efficient than they are).  
(3) Corrected numerator:  
`coalesce((hr.usage_json->>'inputTokens')::numeric, 0) + coalesce((hr.usage_json->>'cacheReadInputTokens')::numeric, 0) + coalesce((hr.usage_json->>'cacheCreationInputTokens')::numeric, 0) + coalesce((hr.usage_json->>'outputTokens')::numeric, 0)`

judgeDetail.rationale: Correctly names the excluded cache fields and gives a null-safe COALESCE numerator summing all four fields without double-counting, all within four tight sentences.
